lina (AE): Heads-up — Wavelength (seed-stage AI infra startup) asked for a 6-week POC. They want $10k in credits + help standing up a VPC/private test env. Standard startup pack is $3k. Can we make an exception?

sam (SE): Do we know model size / qps? Need to size Dedicated vs hosted.

lina (AE): They said using 7B open model, ~200 concurrent sessions but short sequences (avg 150 tokens). POC traffic estimate ~1.5M tokens/week. Also they flagged a security questionnaire (PHI possibility).

sam (SE): With that footprint, hosted will be costly/latency-y. Recommend a short Dedicated trial (1 GPU A100-ish) + prefix caching. That fits into ~$6-8k credits for 6 weeks if we cap usage.

ada (Sales Ops): @lina please submit proposed promo terms so dealdesk can review: amount, TTL, conditions (e.g., commit, usage cap, downgrade path).

lina (AE): Proposed: up to $8k credits for POC, conditioned on (1) 3-month reserved commit if they convert, or (2) usage cap 2M tokens/week; credits expire after 8 weeks. Also request a short onboarding SOW for private env.

omar (Finance): Need rationale for $8k exception vs standard $3k. If they sign 3mo reserved at modal $/token, we can offset. Also require tracking code for promo.

ada (Sales Ops): If dealdesk approves, promo code would be something like `WAVE-POC-1887` (internal). I'll create a reconciliation entry and mark it refundable if commit not met.

security-bot: SSQ intake created: ticket #SSQ-4521. Attachments requested: SOC2 report, network diagram, data flow for PHI. @lina please share customer contact.

morgan (CS): I can lead onboarding for the private test env but need access window and expected days for runbook handoff (2-3 days).

ada (Sales Ops): Deal desk provisional ok for $8k credit conditional on: security sign-off (SSQ-4521 completed), signed 3mo reserved commit OR strict usage cap enforced, and finance OKs final promo accounting.

omar (Finance): I approve conditional exception. Final sign-off after we get the signed commit or confirm cap enforcement mechanics. I'll loop in billing to set the promo ledger code.

lina (AE): Great — I'll send the SSQ contact + ask legal to draft the POC terms (cap + conversion commitment). Will ping back when customer signs SSQ. Thanks all :thumbsup:

sam (SE): I'll prep a short infra checklist and a minimal `docker-compose` snippet for the private env. Drop it here when ready.

morgan (CS): Thumbs up. Planning a 2-day onboarding slot the week after sign-off.

ada (Sales Ops): Promo code created internally: `WAVE-POC-1887` (do not share publicly). Track under opportunity WAVE-1234.

lina (AE): Closing loop: customer ok with conditional terms, sending SSQ contact now. Will update here once SSQ-4521 status is green.

security-bot: SSQ-4521 updated: initial docs received. Pending SOC2 extract and network diagram.
